CNV does not provide independent molecular support for this set. These are descriptive associations within the current partition and do not establish a validated subtype.
limitations: CNV non-significance may reflect limited power or true absence of CNV differences.
WXS PBRM1 depletion is nominal only.

CNV is null, but absence of CNV support does not contradict the identity. Confounder testing shows no significant technical or tissue-source-site association, so measured technical factors do not provide a dominant alternative explanation. Structural metrics are weak (near-zero silhouettes) but do not positively support a Split or Merge, and no pairwise boundary evidence indicates C0001 is insufficiently distinct from another set. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.
